title.context: Budget planner (full screen): heading, {month} is month and year, e.g. 'Plan October 2026'.

editing.context: Budget planner: small line under the heading when the month already has a saved plan.

notSaved.context: Budget planner: small line under the heading for a new plan.

saveFailed.message: Not saved: {error}. Has migration 0005 been run?
saveFailed.context: Budget planner: error when saving fails; {error} is technical. 'Migration 0005' is a database update file.

save.context: Budget planner: main save button; {month} is the month name alone, e.g. 'Save October plan'.

limitOf.context: Budget planner: accessible label of a category's limit field, e.g. 'Food limit'.

typicalPay.context: Budget planner: small tappable chip under Income that fills in the usual monthly pay. Lowercase, short.

plannedIncome.context: Budget planner: accessible label of the income field.

goalsNeed.context: Budget planner: chip under Savings that fills in what the savings goals need per month. Lowercase, short.

goalIn.context: Budget planner (older database): how long the savings goal {name} takes at the planned savings. '~' means about.

goalLeft.context: Budget planner (older database): how much the goal {name} still needs.

goalReached.context: Budget planner (older database): the goal is reached.

plannedSavings.context: Budget planner: accessible label of the savings field.

spendingLimits.context: Budget planner: the sum of all category limits.

noteLabel.context: Budget planner: label of the free-text note for the month; {month} is the month name alone.

notePlaceholder.message: e.g. car insurance 1,200 zł, a birthday, a weekend in Kraków
notePlaceholder.context: Budget planner: placeholder of the note field with examples.

noteHelp.message: Saved with the plan, and the AI draft takes it into account.
noteHelp.context: Budget planner: hint under the note field.

aiDraft.context: Budget planner: heading of the box where the AI proposes a plan.

useAll.context: Budget planner > AI draft: button that applies every AI-suggested limit.

suggestedSavings.context: Budget planner > AI draft: savings the AI proposes. Keep the <b> tags.

aiFootnote.message: Per-category suggestions are shown under each category. Written by {model}. A suggestion, not financial advice.
aiFootnote.context: Budget planner > AI draft: footnote; {model} is the AI model's name.

aiIntroHistory.one: Drafts limits from your last month, the season and your note above.
aiIntroHistory.other: Drafts limits from your last {count} months, the season and your note above.
aiIntroHistory.context: Budget planner > AI draft: explanation before asking the AI.

aiIntroDefaults.message: Drafts limits from your defaults, the season and your note above.
aiIntroDefaults.context: Budget planner > AI draft: explanation when there's no history yet.

draft.context: Budget planner > AI draft: button that asks the AI.

draftAgain.context: Budget planner > AI draft: button that asks the AI again.

draftFailed.context: Budget planner > AI draft: error; {error} is technical.

aiSent.message: Sent to Gemini: monthly totals per category and of income, the goal, your note, and the suggestions above, with the names of yearly bills and regular payments.
aiSent.context: Budget planner > AI draft: privacy footnote listing what goes to Google's Gemini.

suggestions.context: Budget planner: heading of the list of suggestions worked out from past months.

recurring.context: Budget planner: heading of the list of regular payments that come every month (subscriptions, rent).

checks.context: Budget planner: heading of the checks on the draft plan.

limits.context: Budget planner: heading of the per-category limits list.

fillPrevious.context: Budget planner: chip that copies the previous month's limits; {month} is the month name alone, e.g. 'September’s plan'.

fillTypical.context: Budget planner: chip that fills every limit with what the category typically costs.

fillDefaults.context: Budget planner: chip that fills every limit with the category's default from Settings.

openCategory.context: Budget planner: tooltip of a category's name, which opens its history, forecast and share.

hasSuggestion.context: Budget planner: accessible label of a lightbulb icon next to a category with a suggestion.

chipTypical.context: Budget planner: small chip under a category's limit: what it typically costs. Lowercase, very short.

chipLast.context: Budget planner: small chip: what the category cost last month. Lowercase, very short.

used.context: Budget planner: after an AI suggestion that's been applied. Very short.

tapToUse.context: Budget planner: after an AI suggestion that hasn't been applied. Very short.

typicalNote.one: “Typical” is the average of the last complete month. Chips round up to 10 {currency}.
typicalNote.other: “Typical” is the average of the last {count} complete months. Chips round up to 10 {currency}.
typicalNote.context: Budget planner: footnote under the limits.

remove.context: Budget planner: button that deletes the saved plan; {month} is the month name alone.

addIncome.message: Add the income you expect to see whether the plan fits.
addIncome.context: Budget planner: hint when no income is entered.

balanced.context: Budget planner: the plan is balanced (zero-based budgeting: all income is assigned). Adapt 'złoty' to the currency idiom.

overBy.context: Budget planner: the plan assigns more than the income; followed by the amount.

unassigned.context: Budget planner: part of the income has no category or savings yet; followed by the amount.

noteNoIncome.context: Budget planner footer (laptop): status of the plan.

noteBalanced.context: Budget planner footer (laptop): the plan is balanced.

noteOver.context: Budget planner footer (laptop): the plan exceeds the income.

noteUnassigned.context: Budget planner footer (laptop): income not yet assigned.

allCategories.context: Budget planner, one category opened: button back to the list.

inPlan.context: Budget planner, one category opened (short laptop screens): after the category name; {month} is month and year.

otherCategories.context: Budget planner: accessible label of the previous/next category buttons.

previousCategory.context: Budget planner: accessible label of the left arrow.

nextCategory.context: Budget planner: accessible label of the right arrow.

apply.context: Budget planner: button on a suggestion that applies its limit.

recurringIntro.message: {amount} comes every month for about the same amount:
recurringIntro.context: Budget planner > 'Already certain': intro before the list of regular payments; {amount} is their total.

inCategory.context: Budget planner > 'Already certain': after a payment's note, which category it's in. Lowercase.

hiddenCategory.context: Budget planner: used as {name} when the category is hidden.
